description: PRS-007 — synthesize a postmortem + runbook suggestion + KB article from a resolved incident. Anchored to the v0-locked slow-product-catalog scenario; runs deterministically under the stub LLM provider.

cases.description: Resolved product-catalog latency incident: drafts a pending-review KB article, suggests updating the existing product-catalog runbook, leaks no PII.

triage_verdict.alert_summary: Product catalog GetProduct p95 latency above 5s

rca_verdict.root_cause: The flagd feature flag `productCatalogFailure` is on, injecting a deterministic ~5s delay into productcatalogservice GetProduct calls. Latency is isolated to this service.

ranked_fix_steps.description: Set flagd flag productCatalogFailure defaultVariant back to off via the feature-flags seam.
ranked_fix_steps.rollback: Re-flip the flag back to on — instant.
